veranderings.rede: 'Na onder kyk' means looking downwards; the sentence means looking underneath the box, which 'onder die boks' says plainly.
'Terwyl dit onder is' is vague; the previous sentence already speaks of the wheel touching the ground, so this keeps the meaning and is clearer.
